what: The approved road tile (board, 2026-10-12): a 2:1 isometric diamond, 128 x 64 pixels, 2 x 2 units, a white dashed lane line along world y (lower-left to upper-right), light cracks, no pavement or crossing.

lineage: PixelLab /create-tiles-pro call (job 4054b369-2315-473c-9e05-01723cd64b31, tile 1 of 6, 15 generations) -> squashed to 2:1 -> script fix (edge outline removed, line brightened) -> board's hand edit. Full call record: art-archive/T-063/road_tiles.json and raw/.
size: 128 x 64 pixels = 2 x 2 units at 32 art pixels per unit (drawn at scale 0.5 in the game: 64 x 32 screen pixels)
repeat: neighbours at (+64, +32) across the road (world x) and (-64, +32) along it (world y); a 24-unit road is 12 tiles across; exact footprint, 0 gaps and 0 overlaps when tiled
